findings.reason: the section must either add a no-home-branch parameter (or exclude the served-client kind) or restate the done-when as a deliberate, named behaviour change for that kind, otherwise the implementer hits an unsatisfiable gate.
findings.text: §13 folds five cache cascades into `cache_root(kind, *, home_first)` and says they differ only in "two deliberate orders", but `_client_cache_root` has no `RECKON_HOME` step at all (`RECKON_CLIENT_CACHE` → `<XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache>/reckon/client`), so it is a third shape: with `RECKON_HOME` set and `XDG_CACHE_HOME` unset its base resolution is the real user cache, and any `home_first` variant that consults `RECKON_HOME` at all moves it, which §13's own done-when (`each of the five kinds resolves to the directory it resolved to at the base under both an isolated RECKON_HOME and an explicit XDG_CACHE_HOME`) then forbids — the section and its gate contradict each other for this kind

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — `cache_root(kind, *, home_first)` hides the five-cascade resolution behind one boolean order that cannot represent the fifth caller, so the interface is smaller than the behaviour it must preserve.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the section names the existing owners it consolidates rather than forking them: `routing._git` (reckon/crew/routing.py:473) becomes a wrapper over the one runner, and `capabilities.pick_input_cache_root` (reckon/capabilities.py:1143) and `lane_context._profile_cache_root` (reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:261) become callers of the one cascade.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — §12 states its net is zero (adds the sources reader on velocity, retires the public `revised_python`); §13 states `public_definitions` grows by two (the process runner and `cache_root`) with the retired resolvers private, and neither section adds a CLI option, MCP view, or refusal family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §12 and §13 enumerate the machinery they extend (four named git runners `velocity.git`/`routing._git`/`clones._git`/`served_code._git`, 63 direct subprocess git calls, and five cache cascades), and the plan's measured figures reproduce against the tree (reckon/clones.py:644 `_git` returns a process, reckon/velocity.py:147 `git` raises and returns bytes, 1,169 tracked `.py` at HEAD with 98 outside `reckon/` and `tests/`).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the two retained wrappers over the one runner each state why they cannot be the runner (`velocity.git` keeps a bytes-and-raise contract; `routing._git` translates a failed invocation into `CrewError`), which is error-domain translation rather than a parallel mechanism.
